lines.text: Many learners say: I go to health every day.
Better: I go to the gym every day.
Say the gym for a place to work out.
The gym! I work out at the gym after work.

data.wrong: I go to health every day.
data.right: I go to the gym every day.
data.why: Say the gym for a place to work out.

quiz.stem: I work out at ___ after work.

en.tip: Health means how well your body is. Say “I go to the gym every day.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “I go to health every day.” Health means how well your body is. Right: “I go to the gym every day.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
